rationale: E1.5 (Story 1, native sandbox environments, docs/design/environments.md §5.3) adds two real top-level config.toml keys: `environment` (the machine default environment NAME) and `environments` (the name -> canonical absolute local path registry). Both have no hand-edit path at all — `pix config set/unset` refuses them outright and names the correct `pix env` command (workflow/provision/config.go's environmentKeyRefusal); `pix env use`/`pix env add`/`pix env rm` (Wave C) are the only writers.
evidence: services/host/config/config.go (Config.Environment / Config.Environments, applyDefaults' dropNoncanonicalEnvironments); services/host/config/environment.go (CanonicalEnvironmentPath/AddEnvironment/RemoveEnvironment/UseEnvironment); services/host/workflow/provision/config.go (environmentKeyRefusal); services/host/config/environment_test.go; services/host/workflow/provision/config_environment_test.go; services/host/cmd/pix/config_environment_cmd_test.go
